searchText: stupid question: why did we create RLP, and not pick, say, XDR (Stellar uses it)? XDR does not support uint256 afaik the practical answer is that RLP was designed as a more sane replacement for DER encoding which Bitcoin used, which is horrible and has special cases and unneeded features all over the place
